# pkg  top-level test  seconds-in-a-CI-run  part
# Tests of a package that scripts/ci-shard-weights.txt splits are spread over its K parts by a stable hash of the test
# name, which can pile every slow test into one part. A test listed here goes to the given part (0-based, taken mod K)
# instead. Generated by scripts/ci-weights-refresh.sh (longest test first onto the least loaded part; seconds are the
# test's wall time, parallel subtests summed). A name that no longer exists is harmless; a new slow test falls back to the hash.
